messages:
Ellen: Hot take  cocoa-pong tournament in the kitchen Tuesday 4pm? Winner gets the office ugly-mug trophy :trophy:
Raj: Do we dunk marshmallows or just fling mini marshmallows into cups? :thinking:
Becky: Marshmallow toss pls. Also let's do a postcard wall  leave a tiny card with a compliment or a silly doodle.
Tomas: Love both. Can we have a decaf table for folks who avoid caffeine?
Facilities: Please use non-staining mugs and avoid glitter decor. We'll put out paper cups and a small mat for spills.
Ellen: Poll time  react :chocolate_bar: for tournament, :postcard: for postcard wall, :heart: for both.
Kira: I'll volunteer to run the bracket and make a 16-person single-elim sheet. Also playlist volunteer  send recs.
Ops Bot: Note: Kitchen noise should be kept moderate after 4:30. Emergency exits must remain clear.
Raj: I'll add a holiday-lofi playlist. Also marshmallow alternatives for folks with allergies?
Becky: I'll bring gluten-free and nut-safe marshmallow options plus a whipped cream pump. Labelled.
Tomas: I'll bring a stack of blank A6 postcards and pens. Remote folks can DM a one-liner and we'll print them.
Ellen: Consent check: thumbs-up in thread if it's ok to share photos from the event in #random slideshow.
Kira: thumbs up
Becky: thumbs up :thumbsup:
Facilities: Small folding table reserved at 3:45 for supplies and postcards. We'll remove it by 5:30.
Raj: Also tiny prize idea  Facilities mystery mug + sticker pack. Winner picks the mug.
Ellen: Love it. Quick rules: <$10 per team contribution, no alcohol, keep it SFW.
Tomas: I'll tape a little sign by the kitchen: "Cocoa Pong & Postcard Wall  Tue 16:00 - 17:00 ".
Becky: Remote folks  drop your postcard lines here: https://docs.example.com/cocoa-postcards and mark if you want anonymity.
Ellen: Thanks everyone  excited for tiny chaos and warm chocolate. :sparkles:
Raj: Also shoutout to Facilities for last week's tree setup  looked amazing :clap:
Ops Bot: Event created: Tue 16:00-17:00. Please RSVP on the calendar and follow kitchen guidelines.
